subject.title: improve(ci): preserve complete main validation during merge bursts

question: Should an authorized repository owner verify and enforce the GitHub Actions-owned `openclaw/ci-gate` no-role-bypass default-branch ruleset before this main-CI concurrency change merges?
rationale: The required branch-protection/ruleset state is a repository administration boundary that this PR cannot safely establish or prove from source alone.

options.title: Verify the protected-main rollout
options.body: Confirm the ruleset and attach redacted evidence showing one active main run completes, the newest pending push is retained, and the warmer checks out the green run SHA.

options.title: Merge without the external gate
options.body: Accept that the intended CI protection is not yet enforced by the stated default-branch ruleset and schedule owner follow-up separately.

recommendation.title: Verify the protected-main rollout
recommendation.body: Confirm the ruleset and attach redacted evidence showing one active main run completes, the newest pending push is retained, and the warmer checks out the green run SHA.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and current work directly cover this CI-cache lifecycle and its operational rollout.
